note: Interest must post to every account, including the last one in the file.

clauses.text: After the last category balance record has been read, the account update (1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT) is performed once more for the last account group.

As a result, the last account group is updated like every other account: its WS-TOTAL-INT is added to ACCT-CURR-BAL, its cycle credit and debit are set to zero, and its account record is rewritten. If the file is empty, no account is updated at all.
